title: Momentum, Commentary Tone, and Earnings Surprise in LLM Financial Forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2610.22043v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Which inputs drive a language model's financial forecast? We construct synthetic earnings announcements that independently reverse 20-day momentum, non-informational commentary tone, and whether fixed actual EPS beats a manipulated consensus. Six instruction/chat checkpoint conversions from four families (0.49-7.61B base parameters) receive 2,016 prompts each under a direct-answer Q8_0 protocol. The design includes 24 numerical blocks, six commentary pairs, profits and losses, rising and falling annual EPS, and two surprise sizes. Both A/B answer assignments and U/D cover all 384 primary scenarios per conversion. We estimate matched changes in conditional answer-prefix scores, not calibrated market probabilities. Across these checkpoints, the primary EPS contrast ranges from -0.19 to 86.80 percentage points. The magnitude of the primary signed tone contrast exceeds that of EPS in 5 of six models, and momentum exceeds it in 5. Natural-w

translated_title: 大语言模型金融预测中的动量、评论语气与盈利意外
translated_abstract: 是什么输入驱动语言模型的金融预测？我们构建了合成的财报公告，独立地反转20日动量、非信息性的评论语气，以及固定的实际每股收益（EPS）是否超越被操纵的共识预期。来自四个模型家族（基础参数量为4.9亿至76.1亿）的六个指令/对话检查点转换版本，在直接回答的Q8_0协议下各接收2,016条提示。实验设计包含24个数字区块、六组评论配对、盈利与亏损情形、上升与下降的年度EPS，以及两种意外幅度。A/B答案分配与U/D（上涨/下跌）覆盖每个转换版本的全部384个主要情景。我们估计的是条件答案前缀分数的匹配变化，而非校准后的市场概率。在这些检查点中，主要EPS对比的范围为-0.19至86.80个百分点。在六个模型中的五个里，主要符号语气对比的幅度超过了EPS对比，动量对比在其中五个模型中也超过了EPS对比。
tldr: 本研究通过独立操纵动量、评论语气和EPS意外的合成财报实验发现，在大语言模型的金融预测中，非基本面的评论语气和价格动量因素对模型输出的影响往往超过实际的每股收益意外本身，揭示了LLM金融预测易受非信息性输入干扰的问题。
en_tdlr: Through synthetic earnings announcements that independently manipulate momentum, commentary tone, and EPS surprise, this study shows that non-fundamental factors—commentary tone and price momentum—often drive LLM financial forecasts more strongly than the actual earnings surprise itself.
